summary.name: Sharptooth: Bluetooth Hotkeys
summary.one_liner: A macOS menu bar app for connecting, disconnecting, and monitoring Bluetooth devices with hotkeys, battery readouts, and automation scripts.
use_cases: Switch Bluetooth peripherals quickly from the menu bar
Assign keyboard shortcuts to connect or disconnect devices
Check AirPods and other Bluetooth device battery levels
Run scripts when a Bluetooth device connects or disconnects
Avoid digging through System Settings for Bluetooth controls
summary.what_it_does: Sharptooth is a macOS menu bar app for managing Bluetooth devices. It lets you connect and disconnect devices with one click from the menu bar, and assign custom keyboard shortcuts for switching devices. It shows real-time battery levels in the menu bar, including individual AirPods earbuds, and sends low battery alerts and connection status HUD notifications with adjustable thresholds. It can also run custom scripts on device connect or disconnect, and shows details such as MAC address, signal strength, and connection status, with custom names and icons per device.
notable: Menu bar battery readout including individual AirPods earbuds
Custom hotkeys for instant device switching
Run custom scripts on Bluetooth connect/disconnect
caveats: Offers in-app purchases (optional tip-style purchases listed at $3.99 and $1.99)
Listed as $1.99 on the App Store page; the awesome-mac listing calls it freeware, which conflicts with the App Store price
